races.paceDynamic: Alliteration is the only confirmed front runner and will dictate terms from the start, likely setting a sustainable tempo without early pressure. Cool Native, Poetic Twist, Salsinha, and several others will track in the prominent positions, creating a decent-sized group within striking distance. The large field of 18 will likely string out over the soft ground, with the hold-up horses like Thurman, Jo's Secret, and Baby Fish starting from well back. This setup moderately favours prominent runners who can sit close enough to the pace without being caught up in early speed — the singular leader creates a tactical advantage for those tracking rather than those coming from the rear on testing ground.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Trackers Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the soft ground and single pace-setter create a steady tempo that suits those tracking
scenarios.body: The prominent runners can position perfectly behind Alliteration and have enough left to kick clear in the straight. Hold-up horses struggle to make up ground on the testing surface as the field strings out.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Wire-To-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Alliteration gets loose on the front and the soft ground blunts finishing kicks
scenarios.body: Donagh Meyler can dictate a pace that suits his mount's stamina, with the testing conditions making it difficult for closers to reel him in. His perfect record on similar going gives him a major edge.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Late Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely strong with prominent runners pressuring Alliteration early
scenarios.body: The soft ground becomes less of a factor as horses tire up front, allowing the patient riders on Thurman and Jo's Secret to pick up the pieces. Fresh legs from the back prove decisive in a staying test.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Breaks Through
scenarios.trigger: If the market leaders fail to handle the conditions or disappoint on hurdling debut
scenarios.body: Form horses underperform and an improver like Brosna Queen or a hurdling debutant surprises the field. The soft ground levels the playing field for horses with less exposed form.

races.paceDynamic: Bioluminescence will attempt to make all the running from the front, but with no other confirmed pace-setters this looks a moderate gallop early on. Mystical Goddess, Broomfield Bijou, Kilbarry Saint and May Call You Back will likely track the leader in the prominent positions, but none are aggressive front-runners themselves. The race should develop into a sprint finish as the pace quickens from the second-last fence when the prominent horses challenge Bioluminescence. This setup strongly favours the prominent runners who can travel well in behind the uncontested leader and have the tactical speed to strike — hold-up horses may find themselves with too much ground to make up in the straight.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays moderate until the business end
scenarios.body: Mystical Goddess, Kilbarry Saint, and Broomfield Bijou can track Bioluminescence comfortably before unleashing their finishing kicks from ideal positions. The hold-up horses struggle to close the gap as the prominent group have first run on the leaders.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Stays
scenarios.trigger: If Bioluminescence gets an easy lead and finds extra at the business end
scenarios.body: The 8-year-old has shown she can win from the front on soft ground and Mark Walsh times his kick perfectly from the last fence. The chasers leave their challenges too late having given the leader too much rope early.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold Up Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is stronger than expected and the front group comes back dramatically
scenarios.body: Ballybawn Belter and Ad Caelum benefit from a truly-run race where their stamina tells in the final furlong. The early leaders pay for their exertions as the patient riders time their challenges perfectly.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Benefits
scenarios.trigger: If the market leaders fail to fire and connections have found a winnable opportunity
scenarios.body: May Call You Back's recent improvement continues under Brian Hayes for champion trainer Willie Mullins, capitalizing on a light weight. The Mullins stable confidence in running her here after a break suggests she's ready to strike.

races.paceDynamic: Dancing Jeremy and Lord Lariat are the confirmed front-runners, with Dancing Jeremy showing better recent form (won at Fairyhouse over hurdles) while Lord Lariat returns from a 93-day break after falling. With Choccabloc, Lisleigh Lad, The Gradual Slope, Where's Frankie and Harbour Highway all capable of pressing, this creates a solid pace through the early stages. The yielding-to-soft ground and 2m5f trip will test stamina as the pace inevitably tells in the final half-mile. This setup strongly favours hold-up horses — the genuine gallop will string out the field and create opportunities for closers with tactical speed.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is honest and the front-runners weaken approaching two out
scenarios.body: The genuine gallop will stretch the field and allow patient riders to pick off tiring leaders in the straight. Hold-up horses with tactical pace will have first run on weakening front-runners.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners can sit close enough to the pace without being headed
scenarios.body: Choccabloc or Lisleigh Lad can track the leaders without doing too much work early and have enough left to kick clear when the pace tells. Their tactical position gives them the race-winning move.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front-Runner Survives Pressure
scenarios.trigger: If Dancing Jeremy can dictate at a manageable pace and has enough left to repel challenges
scenarios.body: The 11-year-old's course experience and recent Fairyhouse win gives him confidence to control the tempo. His 4W9P record in similar going suggests he can handle the conditions when others falter.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If both Lord Lariat and Dancing Jeremy fail to fire and the early pace becomes moderate
scenarios.body: Without genuine pace-setters, the race becomes tactical and suits horses that can quicken off a slow tempo. The lack of early pressure allows more horses to be competitive turning for home.

races.paceDynamic: Petit Secret, Sine Qua Non, He Can't Dance, and Dubhain will ensure a strong gallop from the outset in this large maiden field. With 26 runners and multiple confirmed front-runners, the pace will be genuine throughout the 2m4f trip on yielding to soft ground. The leaders will string out the field early, with the genuine pace likely to expose stamina limitations in several runners. This setup strongly favours hold-up horses and patient tactics — the early pace will be testing and those who can finish from off the tempo will have a clear advantage.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong pace favours closers
scenarios.trigger: If the front-runners maintain a genuine gallop and string out the field
scenarios.body: The pace will be too strong for many, allowing patient horses like Siege Of Carthage and Largy Star to pick up the pieces. Those held up with stamina will thrive in the testing conditions.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front-runner survives pressure
scenarios.trigger: If one of the pace-setters has the class and stamina to sustain the gallop
scenarios.body: Petit Secret or He Can't Dance could prove too good if they can handle the early pressure and maintain their advantage. Mullins and Elliott horses often show superior fitness levels.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid-race collapse opens door
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes unsustainable and multiple leaders weaken simultaneously
scenarios.body: The race will fall apart in the middle stages, allowing a prominent runner like Midnight Jet or Treasure Memory to inherit the lead. This scenario benefits those who can quicken from a handy position.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Newcomer springs surprise
scenarios.trigger: If one of the lightly-raced horses has been well-prepared and shows natural ability
scenarios.body: The large field and testing conditions could suit a newcomer who has been working well at home. Elliott's multiple runners suggest stable confidence in their chances.

races.paceDynamic: Daydream Nation, Star Of The Week, Hens Tooth, Panjandrum, and Blow Wind Blow form a strong pace carousel that will set a genuine gallop from the outset. With 6 confirmed front-runners in a 21-runner field over 3 miles on soft ground, the early pace will be fierce and stamina-sapping. The leaders will string out the field early, with many runners struggling to stay in touch as the pace bites deep into reserves. This setup strongly favours hold-up horses — the genuine pace will create a perfectly set-up race for closers to pick off tiring leaders.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace leaders go too fast early and fade from 2 furlongs out
scenarios.body: The strong early gallop will set up perfectly for the patient hold-up horses who can quicken late. Gin Tonic, Found A Diamond, and Mystic Malina are perfectly positioned to exploit the pace collapse.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Strike
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent horses can stalk the pace and kick clear when leaders weaken
scenarios.body: Court Compliance or Vitorio Piel could time their move perfectly from tracking positions. Their stamina and tactical speed will prove decisive as pure pace-setters fade.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Leader Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Daydream Nation or Star Of The Week can dictate at a controlled tempo
scenarios.body: Either could slow down the gallop enough to preserve stamina for a strong finish. Their recent form suggests they have the class to make all if not pressured too early.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos and Attrition
scenarios.trigger: If the soft ground and pace combine to cause multiple fallers or pull-ups
scenarios.body: The stamina test becomes extreme with many non-finishers creating opportunities for unfancied stayers. Horses with previous soft ground success come to the fore despite ordinary recent form.

watchPoints.text: If Daydream Nation and Star Of The Week clash heads early, both pace-setters could burn each other out completely
Gin Tonic has been off for 58 days and hold-up horses need everything to fall right in these big handicaps
Found A Diamond wears cheekpieces for first time which could sharpen up this hold-up performer significantly
Willie Mullins runs four horses with Townend choosing Fillyoureye over stable companion Hens Tooth
Multiple amateur jockeys take valuable weight allowances with Found A Diamond, Divaboriva and Minella Emperor all benefiting

races.paceDynamic: Kotkito Bello is the sole confirmed front-runner in this 19-runner field and will get his own way in front, setting a sustainable tempo without early pressure. The prominent runners like Puturhandstogether, Sony Bill, Murcia, Mode Avion, Playtime, Powerful and Kalix Delabarriere will track at a respectful distance, while the majority of the field are hold-up horses who will be held well off the pace. With soft going conditions adding stamina demands and only one leader, the pace will be controlled rather than punishing early. This setup strongly favours hold-up horses — they'll get the steady gallop they need and can unleash their finishing kicks against tired leaders.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Kotkito Bello sets a modest tempo and the prominent group don't apply serious pressure until late.
scenarios.body: The patient hold-up horses get the ideal scenario with plenty left for their finishing efforts, while the early pace-setters have nothing left when the real racing begins. The soft ground adds to the stamina test and favours those coming from behind.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Wins
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners track closer than usual and one kicks clear before the hold-up horses can respond.
scenarios.body: A horse like Puturhandstogether or Murcia gets first run on the field and builds an unassailable lead in the final furlong. The hold-up horses are caught flat-footed by the change of pace.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Kotkito Bello Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is pedestrian throughout and no horse can mount a serious challenge to the leader.
scenarios.body: The front-runner maintains his advantage all the way to the line, benefiting from the soft ground and controlled gallop. His recent form suggests he's capable of lasting home when getting his own way.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is so slow that the race becomes a sprint finish with the entire field bunched.
scenarios.body: The race turns into a cavalry charge from the final hurdle with any horse capable of winning in a blanket finish. Form and class become secondary to position and luck in running.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Kotkito Bello gets loose on the lead — with no pace pressure he could steal this wire-to-wire
Monitor the prominent group tracking distance — if they let Kotkito Bello get too far clear they'll never catch him
Keep eye on Mode Avion's jumping — this 4-year-old has only faced heavy ground and first time at this level
Watch for late market moves on any Mullins runners — stable has multiple chances and late stable confidence often shows
Sea Of Sands and Lord Erskine both return from breaks — watch for any signs of ring-rustiness early

races.paceDynamic: Lilannbee will lead this field from the front, setting a sustainable pace with no immediate pressure from the prominent runners Lizzie Twigg, Something Fabulous, Belladaball and Some Pretender settling just behind. The three hold-up horses Moyneard, Wonderful Everyday and Voladora Nora will track from the rear, creating a well-strung out field over this 2m trip. With only one genuine front-runner and several patient hold-up types, the pace will be solid but not extreme early, before quickening significantly from the 3f pole as the field compresses. This setup moderately favours the hold-up horses — they'll get the strong pace they need and can time their challenges late when the prominent runners have done their work.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Strike Late
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is genuine and hold-up horses get clear runs from 2f out
scenarios.body: Wonderful Everyday and Moyneard will have first run on the leaders as they tire, with their patient tactics paying dividends in the closing stages. The prominent pack will have done too much work chasing Lilannbee's solid gallop.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Control
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is steady and prominent horses conserve energy
scenarios.body: Lizzie Twigg and Some Pretender can dictate terms from ideal positions, using their class and recent form to strike at the business end. They avoid the tactical complications of needing luck in running.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Lilannbee Stays On
scenarios.trigger: If the front-runner gets an uncontested lead and finds extra reserves
scenarios.body: Despite her inconsistent recent form, Lilannbee's front-running style could prove effective on this testing ground if she's allowed an easy time in front. Her trainer S G Carey has a strong 67% strike rate from limited runners this fortnight.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Surprise Package
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses or the market leaders underperform
scenarios.body: Belladaball or Voladora Nora could benefit from a messy pace scenario where class horses don't fire, allowing them to pick up the pieces late. Both have shown glimpses of ability in previous runs.

watchPoints.text: Wonderful Everyday has the highest rating but showed nothing in her last two runs - if she's lost her ability this opens up the race significantly
Something Fabulous returns from a long break with first-time headgear - market support would suggest connections expect a big run
Lilannbee's trainer S G Carey has a 67% strike rate from just three runners - any of his horses warrant respect despite patchy form
Willie Mullins runs both Some Pretender and Wonderful Everyday - which one gets the stronger ride from the family jockeys could be telling
The soft ground throughout the card at Fairyhouse is riding consistently - no bias to report from earlier races
